title: Runebender agent capability map
scope: A compact routing and safety map, not a stable API specification. In a live MCP session, tools/list is authoritative for names, schemas, and availability.

read_first: repository DESIGN.md, using the public template when absent
the smallest Runebender documentation page that matches the task
context_contract.visual_evidence: Inspect returned proof images before making visual judgments. Report the limitation if the client cannot receive images or render PDFs.
context_contract.identity: Use glyph_inventory to resolve Unicode values and mark labels. Confirm explicit master indices after connecting.
context_contract.family_safety: A live proposal does not replace a family-wide compatibility review. Preserve compatible structure unless an authorized redraw says otherwise.

surfaces.use_for: Interactive work against a native editor, including unsaved geometry and revision-checked proposals.
surfaces.availability: Native GPUI and Xilem editors on macOS and Linux; not the browser editor or Windows.
surfaces.safety: Read before proposing. Proposals leave the foreground unchanged. Only install or apply when the designer explicitly asks. No live MCP tool saves the font.

surfaces.use_for: Repeatable builds, batch automation, and tools that operate on UFO/designspace files.
surfaces.access: Saved files only; cannot read unsaved canvas work.
surfaces.safety: Use version control, state affected paths, and do not overwrite sources without authorization.

surfaces.use_for: Local font-ml inference over local sources.
surfaces.safety: Check font-ml tasks before claiming that a job is implemented. Treat results as proposals requiring visual review.

surfaces.use_for: Visual inspection or commands with no structured interface.
surfaces.safety: Do not use screen coordinates for geometry when live MCP or saved-source operations are available.

default_workflow: Choose the surface that exposes the needed state with the least ambiguity.
Confirm document, master, glyph identity, design brief, and approved references.
Inspect geometry and visual proof evidence.
Make a small named proposal or isolated branch.
Proof and report evidence, uncertainty, and compatibility risks.
Apply only with explicit authorization; re-proof afterward; leave saving to the designer.
boundaries: Runebender stores no hosted-model credentials; authentication and approval policy belong to the client.
Experiment versions are session-only. Export an important version as a new UFO before closing.
A disk-mutating model process must not receive the live root source path.
